<analysis>Bean Validation moved to jakarta.validation (Jakarta EE 9+); spring-boot-starter-validation brings jakarta.validation-api, but these sources still import javax.validation (the rewrite left this service's sources untouched). The script renames javax.validation.* to jakarta.validation.* in the case's files (imports and fully qualified names).</analysis>
<script>
import re

def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen


def fix(p):
    for path in error_files(p):
        n = p.sub(path, r"\bjavax\.validation\.", "jakarta.validation.")
        p.log(f"{path}: javax.validation -> jakarta.validation ({n})" if n else f"{path}: nothing to change")
</script>
